hypothesis: R232 (SG&A + OCF margin + gross-margin trend) passed 11 of 12 gates and failed only G1 (discovery relative return -1.01pp). R224 (SG&A + gross-margin stability) passed G1 strongly (+16.14pp discovery relative return) but failed only G7 (recent 12m -2.36%). The two composites cover four economically distinct quality dimensions that are pairwise near-orthogonal: cost discipline, revenue-to-cash efficiency, pricing-power trend, and margin stability. Audited mean absolute monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlations among the four components are at most 0.19742 over 52 months. A four-component equal-weight composite may fix R232's discovery weakness while preserving its recent strength.

factor.missing_policy: all four components must be non-null; no filling, no fallback to any single factor or subset
factor.rationale: Each component captures one quality dimension: SG&A level = cost discipline; OCF margin = revenue-to-cash efficiency; gross-margin YoY improvement = pricing-power direction; gross-margin stability = margin predictability. Equal weights are a fixed prior, not an optimized allocation. All pairwise correlations were audited before this preregistration.

universe.rule: historical HS300 members excluding industry_l1 in {银行, 非银金融}
universe.industry_source: current ext_hy_ths industry snapshot; not historical PIT

control_strategy.purpose: Same non-financial universe, four-component availability filter and execution; none of the four components is scored.

execution.universe: historical non-financial HS300 membership; daily snapshots from 2022

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2022-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2022-2026 curve

gates.D1: four-component coverage within historical non-financial HS300 membership over 2022-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: first valid four-component value occurs by 2022-06-30 and recent-12m coverage is at least 95%
gates.D3: mean absolute monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation is at most 0.70 for every pair among the four components
gates.G1: discovery 2022-2024 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: discovery 2022-2024 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2025-2026 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G9: candidate full-sample total return is at least the R221 SG&A-level candidate full-sample total return minus 5pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. The component set, equal weights, non-financial universe, scoring weights, holding period and stop loss are frozen before the strategy backtest. No post-result relaxation, filling, reweighting, or substitution with other factors is allowed.
known_limitations: The industry classification is a current snapshot, not a historical PIT industry series.
Financial tables are current snapshots; statutory deadlines are used because provider announcement dates are not reliable first-disclosure timestamps.
All four components are research-only; the composite inherits their factor-construction caveats.
Equal weights are a fixed prior, not an optimized allocation.
This is the fourth composite built from the same component family; multiple-comparison risk is acknowledged and no gate is relaxed.
The factor is research-only until every pre-registered gate passes.
